name: ship-game
description: Immersive browser-based sailing game — Angular client + secure Bedrock/Polly API

scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w @ship-game/server && npm run build -w client
scripts.build:server: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w @ship-game/server
scripts.build:client: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w client && npm run lint -w @ship-game/server && npm run lint -w shared
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w @ship-game/server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w @ship-game/server && npm run test -w client
